title: It’s not the LLM, it’s the human that exploits it
description: A researcher quit Anthropic and warned AI could kill us all. The same day, I used it to read wiring schematics nobody on site could read.

title: Earn the Room
description: America is fighting the AI buildout on two fronts. One is real. The other we started ourselves.

title: The Bottleneck Was Never the GPU
description: China’s rare earth export controls return November 10, 2026. The AI data center buildout has a single point of failure, and it is not the chip.
